scope: Schema portion of issue #81 (epic #74). Live paired single/dual trials land after #82; this file pins the task classes those trials must cover.
metric: Reports compare total trajectory cost, not only expensive-model tokens.

reproducibility.pricing: Provider-reported cost wins; else GARUDA_TOKEN_PRICES override; else the garuda/eval/pricing.py snapshot with SNAPSHOT_VERSION pinned per report; bundled litellm table only for unlisted models.
reproducibility.unknown_cost: Unknown cost is recorded as null with a reason and excluded from savings, never compared as zero.
reproducibility.versions: Fix model versions, prompts, prices, and seeds where supported before comparing. Single-trial scores stay single-trial.

categories.description: Read-heavy exploration: locate files, extract snippets, enumerate symbols across the repository.
examples: locate every retry handler and extract the backoff snippets
enumerate the symbols exported by the workspace module

categories.description: Debugging against a failing check: reproduce, isolate, fix with verification.
examples: reproduce the failing lease-takeover test and fix the heartbeat race

categories.description: Small implementation with verification: a bounded change plus passing checks.
examples: add the missing fallback counter and cover it with a focused test

categories.description: Document analysis: PDF, spreadsheet, or image evidence extraction.
examples: extract the pricing table from the benchmark PDF

categories.description: Tasks where delegation must not be used: pure edits or single-file reasoning. Pins over-delegation: a candidate that spends collection jobs here regresses even if it succeeds.
examples: rename one local variable in a single file
answer from one short file already in context
